cohort: Pregnant women undergoing first trimester screening for aneuploidies, from whom cases (seeking pregnancy for 12-24 months) and age-matched controls (conceiving in less than 1 year) were selected.
finding: The study found no significant relationship between serum 25-OH-vitamin D levels or vitamin D insufficiency and the time to natural pregnancy.
cross-section timing: During the first trimester of pregnancy, for the measurement of serum 25-OH-vitamin D levels.
